title: Detecting intracellular thiol redox state in leukaemia and heterogeneous immune cell populations: An optimised protocol for digital flow cytometers
author: Wadley, Morgan, et al.
materials: 1Complete IMDM tissue culture medium: containing 10% (v/v) foetal calf serum (FCS), 2 mM l-glutamine, 100 U/ml penicillin and 100 mg/ml streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK).2Hank’s balanced salt solution (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #H9269).3Dulbecco’s phosphate buffered saline (D-PBS) endotoxin tested, pH 7.0 (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #D8537).4Flow cytometry stain buffer (FSB): d-PBS adjusted to contain 2% (v/v) FCS, 0.1% (w/v) sodium azide and 5 mM EDTA (stored at 4 °C).5Ficoll-Paque PLUS (GE, Buckinghamshire, UK; catalogue #17144003) or Hisopaque 1077 (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #10771).6Trypan blue solution 0.4% (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #T8154).7Glucose oxidase from Aspergillus niger (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #G2133): 100,000 U/g.8N-ethylmaleimide (NEM): 1 mM stock in d-PBS stored at 4 °C protected from light (Sigma-Aldrich, Dorset, UK; catalogue #E3876).9Fluorescein-5 maleimide (F5M): 1 mM stock in d-PBS stored at 4 °C protected from light (ThermoFisher, Hampshire, UK; catalogue #62245).10Anti-human CD3-APC, clone SK7 (BioLegend, London, UK; catalogue #344812).11Multi-parameter digital flow cytometer.Note: in our laboratory we use an Accuri-C6 (BD-Accuri, Berkshire, UK); however, the method is compatible with other digital systems e.g. Guava® EasyCyte (MerkMillipore, Hertfordshire, UK)12NuPAGE 4–12% SDS-PAGE gel, MOPS running buffer and SDS-PAGE LDS sample loading buffer (ThermoFisher, Hampshire, UK)

The method details are as follows:1Maintain Jurkat cells in 15 ml complete IMDM, at a density between 2 × 105 and 106 cells/ml at 37 °C and 5% CO2.Note: IMDM is particularly suited to this because of the high glucose concentration (4.5 g/l), which is a substrate for GOX.2Prepare a 10 mU/ml GOX solution and a 10 mg/ml catalase solution and store at 4 °C until required.Note: The catalase is used to confirm that H2O2 is mediating changes in thiol redox state. To prepare glucose oxidase solutions for in vitro H2O2 generation, it is recommended to obtain high purity glucose oxidase solid (e.g. Sigma cat no. 49180 or similar quality). Cheaper preparations can contain confounding contaminants such as catalase, which metabolises H2O

steps.title: Prepare GOX and catalase stocks
steps.instruction: In a Class 2 biosafety cabinet dissolve solid glucose oxidase (GOX) to 1 U ml⁻¹ in tissue‑culture‑grade water, filter‑sterilise, aliquot and store at –20 °C; thaw a 1 U ml⁻¹ aliquot at 37 °C for 1 min and dilute immediately with water to make a 10 mU ml⁻¹ working solution. Prepare a 10 mg ml⁻¹ catalase stock in the same way and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Maintain Jurkat cells
steps.instruction: Culture Jurkat cells in 15 ml complete IMDM (10 % FCS, 2 mM L‑glutamine, 100 U ml⁻¹ penicillin, 100 mg ml⁻¹ streptomycin) at 2 × 10⁵–1 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹, 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest and count Jurkat cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the contents of a 24–48 h Jurkat flask (60–80 % confluent) to a 15 ml tube, centrifuge 100–300 × g for 10 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml pre‑warmed complete IMDM, perform a trypan‑blue viable count and dilute to 1 × 10⁷ viable cells ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Plate cells for GOX time‑course
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of the 1 × 10⁷ cells ml⁻¹ suspension to each of five wells of a 96‑well tissue‑culture‑treated plate and label ‘0 h’, ‘1 h’, ‘2 h’, ‘3 h’, ‘4 h’. Add 98 µl to two additional wells and label ‘0 h +C’ and ‘4 h +C’.

steps.title: Add catalase to control wells
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl of the 10 mg ml⁻¹ catalase stock to wells ‘0 h +C’ and ‘4 h +C’ only.

steps.title: Start GOX incubation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of the 10 mU ml⁻¹ GOX solution to wells ‘4 h’ and ‘4 h +C’, then incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add GOX at successive time points
steps.instruction: After 1 h add 100 µl GOX to ‘3 h’; after another 1 h add 100 µl GOX to ‘2 h’; after another 1 h add 100 µl GOX to ‘1 h’; finally, 1 h after the ‘1 h’ addition, add 100 µl GOX to ‘0 h’ and ‘0 h +C’. Immediately transfer the contents of all seven wells to a fresh 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled tube at 100–300 × g for 5 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml d‑PBS, centrifuge again 100–300 × g for 5 min at RT.

steps.title: Stain intracellular thiols with F5M
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml pre‑chilled 0.1 µM F5M (stock 1 mM in d‑PBS) and incubate 20 min on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after F5M staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 100–300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 ml pre‑chilled flow‑cytometry stain buffer (FSB: d‑PBS + 2 % FCS, 0.1 % NaN₃, 5 mM EDTA), centrifuge again 100–300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Final resuspension for acquisition
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 100 µl FSB, keep on ice protected from light and proceed to flow cytometry.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run the ‘0 h’ sample first, then the remaining samples in chronological order. Gate on the Jurkat population (FSC/SSC), create an FL1 histogram (λ488 nm, 530/30 nm). Exclude non‑viable cells (<8 %) using a viability dye such as 7‑AAD if desired.

steps.title: Collect peripheral blood for PBMCs
steps.instruction: Draw 6 ml venous blood from a consented donor into a 6 ml K₂EDTA tube.

steps.title: Dilute blood with HBS
steps.instruction: Transfer the 6 ml blood to a sterile tube and add 6 ml Hank’s balanced salt solution (HBS) for a total of 12 ml.

steps.title: Layer over Ficoll‑Paque
steps.instruction: In three sterile 15 ml tubes add 3 ml Ficoll‑Paque PLUS, then carefully layer 4 ml of the diluted blood on top of each Ficoll layer.

steps.title: Density‑gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 × g for 40 min at 18–20 °C with brake off using a swing‑out rotor.

steps.title: Harvest PBMC layer
steps.instruction: In the biosafety cabinet, remove plasma (upper layer) to waste, then transfer the white PBMC interface to a fresh 15 ml tube, avoiding Ficoll contamination.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs (first wash)
steps.instruction: Add 8 ml HBS to each tube, centrifuge 100–300 × g for 10 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend each pellet in 1 ml HBS. Pool all resuspended PBMCs and bring volume to 10 ml with HBS.

steps.title: Wash PBMCs (second wash)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled PBMCs 100–300 × g for 10 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 ml pre‑warmed (37 °C) complete IMDM, then incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until analysis.

steps.title: Prepare F5M working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the 1 mM F5M stock in d‑PBS to 0.1 µM, protect from light and store at 4 °C (up to 1 month) or –20 °C (up to 1 year).

steps.title: Wash PBMCs before staining
steps.instruction: Remove PBMCs from the incubator, centrifuge 100–300 × g for 5 min at RT, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 ml d‑PBS (RT), centrifuge again 100–300 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 ml FSB.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension for counting
steps.instruction: Make a 1:20 dilution of the PBMC suspension in FSB (5 µl cells + 95 µl FSB), keep the remainder on ice.

steps.title: Count viable PBMCs
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of the 1:20 dilution with 10 µl trypan blue, load a haemocytometer and determine viable cell concentration.

steps.title: Aliquot PBMCs for staining
steps.instruction: Adjust the undiluted PBMC suspension to 1 × 10⁷ viable cells ml⁻¹ with chilled FSB, dispense 100 µl (1 × 10⁶ cells) into three 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes, centrifuge 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after pelleting
steps.instruction: Discard supernatants and resuspend each pellet in 90 µl FSB.

steps.title: Add surface antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl mouse anti‑human CD3‑APC (clone SK7) to two tubes; add 10 µl mouse IgG1‑APC isotype control to the third tube.

steps.title: Incubate surface stain
steps.instruction: Vortex briefly (1–2 s), incubate on ice 30 min protected from light.

steps.title: Wash post‑surface stain
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml chilled d‑PBS to each tube, centrifuge 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Label tubes for F5M and NEM controls
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml chilled d‑PBS to the isotype control tube and to one CD3‑APC tube (label this ‘F5M’). Add 1 ml 1 µM NEM solution to the remaining CD3‑APC tube (label ‘NEM’).

steps.title: Incubate NEM and F5M controls
steps.instruction: Incubate all three tubes 20 min on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Wash after NEM/F5M incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant; resuspend each pellet in 1 ml chilled d‑PBS, centrifuge again 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Add F5M to NEM and F5M tubes
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml chilled d‑PBS to the isotype control tube; add 1 ml 0.1 µM F5M to both the ‘NEM’ and ‘F5M’ tubes.

steps.title: Incubate F5M staining
steps.instruction: Incubate all three tubes 20 min on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Final washes before acquisition
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant; resuspend each pellet in 1 ml pre‑chilled FSB, centrifuge again 5 min at 100–300 × g, 4 °C; repeat once more.

steps.title: Final resuspension for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Remove supernatants and resuspend each pellet in 100 µl pre‑chilled FSB, keep on ice protected from light.

steps.title: Acquire PBMC flow data
steps.instruction: At the flow cytometer first acquire the Ig‑control sample (set positive T‑cell gate on FL4, λ640 nm, 675/25 nm), then acquire the ‘NEM’ sample to define FL1 background, and finally acquire the ‘F5M’ sample (FL1, λ488 nm, 530/30 nm). Verify viability with trypan‑blue counts before or after acquisition.

steps.title: Treat Jurkat cells for protein analysis
steps.instruction: Set up two 15 ml tubes: (i) 2 × 10⁶ Jurkat cells + 1 µM NEM for 20 min then 20 µM F5M for 20 min; (ii) 2 × 10⁶ Jurkat cells + 0.1 µM F5M for 20 min. Perform the F5M incubations exactly as described for the flow‑cytometry sections.

steps.title: Harvest cells after labeling
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the treated Jurkat cells 100–300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash before lysis
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add 10 ml pre‑chilled FSB, centrifuge 100–300 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend each pellet in 400 µl pre‑chilled PBS and transfer to fresh microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the PBS suspensions on ice (keep lysates protected from light) to achieve complete lysis.

steps.title: Clarify lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysates 12 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, collect supernatants into fresh tubes on ice, protect from light.

steps.title: Quantify protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration of each extract using a Bradford assay (or equivalent).

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Add 20 µg of each protein extract to non‑reducing NuPAGE LDS sample buffer, bring volume to 20 µl, heat 70 °C for 10 min protected from light, cool before loading.

steps.title: Assemble and run SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Set up a NuPAGE 4–20 % gradient gel with 1× MOPS running buffer, load samples with molecular‑weight marker, run at 180 V for 60–80 min (until dye front exits). Keep gel and tank protected from light throughout.

steps.title: Image fluorescent proteins
steps.instruction: Immediately after electrophoresis, place the gel in a tray of dH₂O and scan with a Typhoon‑9400 (excitation 490–495 nm, emission 515–520 nm).

steps.title: Fix gel
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel directly into SDS‑PAGE fix solution, incubate 15 min at RT with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Coomassie stain
steps.instruction: Rinse gel in dH₂O, add G‑250 colloidal Coomassie blue reagent, incubate overnight (10–20 h) at RT with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Destain gel
steps.instruction: Remove Coomassie solution, destain with dH₂O for 2 h at RT with gentle agitation, changing the water every 20 min.

steps.title: Final gel imaging and analysis
steps.instruction: Scan the gel on a flat‑bed SDS‑PAGE scanner, analyse fluorescence and Coomassie images using ImageQuant v8.1 (or equivalent) to compare band intensities between NEM + F5M and F5M‑only samples.
